summary: Lead research for Resource Pro MVP (resource management and allocation platform). Targets workforce development centers, business consulting firms, and professional services organizations in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio that could benefit from resource planning, allocation, and management tools.

leads.fit_rationale: All-in-one workforce resource center providing job training and workforce development services. Resource management platform would help track client resources, training programs, and service allocation.
Focuses on workforce development and business resources. Resource Pro platform would help manage business assistance programs and workforce initiatives.
Provides Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) consulting in Northeast Ohio. Resource management platform could complement or compete with their ERP solutions for smaller businesses.
Ohio-based ERP consulting firm serving professional services. Resource Pro could serve as a lighter alternative for businesses not ready for full ERP implementation.
Serves manufacturing, nonprofits, and municipal services in NE Ohio with IT resource management. Partnership opportunity for integrated resource planning tools.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add resource allocation dashboard with utilization metrics.
Include project-based resource planning and scheduling.
Create skill matrix for matching resources to projects.
Add capacity planning with forecasted demand.
Provide time tracking integrated with resource allocation.
Include reporting on resource efficiency and utilization rates.
Add mobile app for field staff resource updates.
Create API for integration with existing ERP systems.

possible_issues: Resource management tools need clean, data-dense interfaces without clutter.
Poor visualization of resource allocation makes planning difficult.
Without real-time updates, resource data becomes stale quickly.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Resource management platforms are highly white-labelable for consulting firms, workforce centers, and professional services with custom branding and workflows.
